note: Golden v2 viewer bodies. Not gzipped: every writer must produce these bytes. Do not hand-edit; re-vendor with `bun run fixtures`.

fixtures.name: basic
fixtures.note: Subgroup stream runs on draft 20: FIRST_OBJECT known, EOG with FIN, a run open at seal, tl, and a ctrl record keeping its raw control bytes.

fixtures.name: zero-length-normal
fixtures.note: Zero-length Normal objects are arrivals with 0 bytes, per draft family (8, 14, 20), on a subgroup stream, as datagrams and on FETCH; no mark is written for them.

fixtures.name: datagram-arrival-order
fixtures.note: A datagram run keeps arrival order: ids 5, 3, 4, 9 are signed deltas, a repeat is kept, EOG flag set.

fixtures.name: fetch-paths
fixtures.note: A standalone FETCH stream carrying groups 11 then 10 (descending order), a joining FETCH on draft 14, a fill on draft 22 with a datagram-flagged object.

fixtures.name: reset-cont-negative
fixtures.note: A reset run with its code, a cont run open at seal, times going backward (negative dt, negative tl), a seq 2 body.

fixtures.name: marks
fixtures.note: Marks as received: FETCH range markers (non-existent after the previous entry at {10, 0}; timed out as the first entry of its stream, so from the request start), Prior Group and Object ID Gaps, an undefined status, End of Track (22); End of Track and Group, Does Not Exist (8); End of Subgroup (7); a datagram mark has no stream id.

fixtures.name: u64-ids
fixtures.note: u64 everywhere: an alias of 2^64-1, group 2^64-1, a large stream id and subgroup id.

fixtures.name: stream-ends
fixtures.note: Stream ends no run carries: a FIN after the run was sealed, EOG + FIN on a subgroup stream with no object (draft 20), a reset FETCH stream with no object, a FETCH End of Group alone and then a FIN on draft 23.

fixtures.name: ident
fixtures.note: A session's identity: the first ident carries every field it has, a later one what setContext set (actor, one tag added), an empty content clears it.

fixtures.name: unknown-draft-unseen-fetch
fixtures.note: A connection whose draft the monitor did not see: no per-draft check applies. A FETCH stream on draft 14 whose request the monitor did not see: path fetch_unseen, ids as decoded.

fixtures.name: bw-seconds
fixtures.note: Bytes per connection, direction and device second: received and sent on two connections, a second at the seal's edge, and a pre total of bytes before init() that no second places. The id was read from the tab's storage.

fixtures.name: sent-objects
fixtures.note: Objects the page sent and objects it received on one connection: a run on a sent alias and one on a received alias, each object with its start, its last payload byte and its size.

fixtures.name: conn-ends
fixtures.note: v2 conn-open and conn-close with device times, one per cause: closed by the relay with its code and reason, failed before it was ready, the page ending, and a terminated worker, each with the monitor counters. The id was minted and written.

fixtures.name: group-timing
fixtures.note: The basic body at group timing: the batch record's timing, and each run's t0, payload bytes and tl with no per-object start, end or size.

fixtures.name: raised
fixtures.note: A later body (seq 1) sealed at raised detail (lvl headers).

fixtures.name: refuse-stream-end-eog-reset
fixtures.note: EOG on a subgroup stream that was reset: a reset loses the end of group.

fixtures.name: refuse-fetch-eog-before-23
fixtures.note: A FETCH End of Group stream end on draft 20, which has no such marker.

fixtures.name: refuse-pace
fixtures.note: A pace record in a viewer body.

fixtures.name: refuse-gs
fixtures.note: gs on a viewer run: only the source knows a group start.

fixtures.name: refuse-fo-known-on-datagram
fixtures.note: fo_known on a datagram run.

fixtures.name: refuse-datagram-subgroup
fixtures.note: A datagram run carrying a subgroup id.

fixtures.name: refuse-fo-known-before-18
fixtures.note: fo_known on draft 14, which has no FIRST_OBJECT bit.

fixtures.name: refuse-fill-before-20
fixtures.note: A fill stream on draft 14.

fixtures.name: refuse-joining-fetch-after-19
fixtures.note: A joining FETCH on draft 20, which removed it.

fixtures.name: refuse-datagram-eog-before-12
fixtures.note: A datagram END_OF_GROUP on draft 11, which has no such flag.

fixtures.name: refuse-bad-ss
fixtures.note: ss names no source of the browsing-session id: it is stored, new or page, or absent.

fixtures.name: refuse-bw-undeclared-conn
fixtures.note: A bw entry names a connection the body does not list.

fixtures.name: refuse-bw-zero-second
fixtures.note: A bw second with no bytes: only seconds with bytes are listed.

fixtures.name: refuse-instance-mismatch
fixtures.note: The batch record names another instance than the preamble.

fixtures.name: refuse-source-body
fixtures.note: A source body posted to the viewer path.
